BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   B. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

13. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.

15. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
